newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain forces arrest Shi'ite protesters-agency.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain forces arrest Shi'ite protesters-agency.

text.p: Bahraini security forces on Monday arrested demonstrators in a Shi'ite village near the capital who were protesting against the death of a Shi'ite Moslem, eyewitnesses and the official Gulf News Agency (GNA) said.
GNA late on Monday quoted an official Interior Ministry source as saying security forces took action after a group of people began riots and committed security violations in Sanabis village.

"Security officials attempted to convince the people to leave quietly to maintain security and order. But when they failed to respond and continued their rioting and security violations, the security authorities took the necessary measures to disperse this gathering and restore calm and order in the area," the source was quoted as saying.
"Some of the elements who instigated unrest and illegimate gatherings were arrested," the source added. MG
